name: theme
title: Raqt theme
description: The Raqt design tokens as one CSS file: colour, typography, spacing, radius and elevation. Paints the `.raqt` class and nothing else, so it retints only what is inside a `<div className="raqt">` and leaves the rest of the host app untouched. Add `light` alongside it for the light mode (`className="raqt light"`); dark is the default. Import it once, after the app's own stylesheet. Every Raqt component depends on this item.
